title: CRUD APIs
definition: CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update, and Delete. These are the four basic operations of persistent storage. In Express, you map these operations directly to HTTP Methods and Route Handlers to build a standard API.

answers.question: When should you avoid using CRUD APIs?
